fields.ch_template_hint: Pick a template — the log table is created automatically on save. Leave empty to manage the table manually.

webhook.hint: Receive webhooks at POST /v1/callback/{path}. The signature is HMAC-SHA256 of the raw request body using the secret above, hex-encoded, optionally prefixed (e.g. "sha256=") and placed in the header.

auth.basic_in_hint: Format: login:password separated by a colon (e.g. admin:s3cret). The client sends Authorization: Basic base64(login:password) — no need to base64-encode here.
auth.basic_out_hint: Format: login:password separated by a colon (e.g. admin:s3cret). Nexus base64-encodes it and sets Authorization: Basic … on the request to the node.
auth.token_in_hint: Token value only, without the "Bearer " prefix. The client sends Authorization: Bearer <token>.
auth.token_out_hint: Token value only, without the "Bearer " prefix. Nexus sets Authorization: Bearer <token> on the request to the node.
auth.token_from_request_hint: The token is taken from the incoming request (query / header / body field) and placed into Authorization: Bearer on the request to the node; the original value is stripped from the proxied request.
auth.basic_from_request_hint: The incoming Authorization: Basic … header is forwarded to the node as-is (Nexus stores no credentials).

form.forward_headers_hint: which headers to pass to the target node
form.incoming_method_hint: HTTP method the node accepts; other methods get 405
form.outgoing_method_hint: HTTP method used to call the target
form.max_body_hint: max characters; request/response are truncated to this value
form.ssrf_warn: "From request" mode: fill the host allowlist to prevent SSRF. Do not leave it empty in production.

rmq.host_hint: 5672 for AMQP, 5671 for AMQPS. The TLS certificate must be trusted.
rmq.queue_hint: The queue must already exist and be bound to the exchange. Nexus does not create queues in v1.
rmq.interval_hint: How often the worker fetches a batch. Allowed 1–3600.
rmq.prefetch_hint: AMQP basic.qos. Defaults to the batch size.
rmq.degraded_desc: Cannot reach RabbitMQ or the queue is missing. Messages are not lost — they stay in the queue. The node returns to active automatically once the connection recovers.
